text:
AN350
Violence and Terrorism
0.5 Credit
Hours per week:
Lecture/Discussion: 3
This
course
examines a wide range of anthropological perspectives on violence and terrorism. Topics explored include everyday violence, genocide and ethnic war, state violence and terrorism, and gendered violence in diverse western and nonwestern contexts.
Additional Course Information
Prerequisites
Registration Status: Year 3 or Year 4
Exclusions
AN307T
